mapper.sql: s.id, s.workspace_id, s.created_by_user_id, s.title, s.visibility, s.status, CASE WHEN s.created_by_user_id = #{userId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS owned_by_current_user, s.last_message_at, s.archived_at, s.created_at, s.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_chat_session s WHERE s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_session (workspace_id, created_by_user_id, title, visibility, status) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{createdByUserId}, #{title}, #{visibility}, #{status})
INSERT INTO ai_chat_session_participant (workspace_id, session_id, user_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{sessionId}, #{userId})
INSERT INTO ai_chat_message (workspace_id, session_id, seq, author_kind, author_user_id, content) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{sessionId}, #{seq}, #{authorKind}, #{authorUserId}, #{content})
